timing_policy.cpu: same dedicated physical cores; official/main/candidate serial; one cold-process warmup then 3 paired samples; separate loaded API warmup+3 samples
timing_policy.gpu: same H100 PCIe; common GPU lock; 20e9 byte allocation limit; AB/BA loaded API worker pair, 3 samples per worker
timing_policy.output: uncompressed complete NIfTI; no image slicing or synthetic data in benchmark
timing_policy.precision_regions: strict FSL float32 postmat/voxel-query bounds; positive_reference uses intensity>0

gpu_default_stage_diagnosis.scope: two ABA independently imported workers per source; six full IO samples; stages measured separately from full IO; profiler call excluded from wall samples
